description: This file defines a React component 'OverlayChartDialog' for uploading CSV files and overlaying charts using Plotly. It includes functions for handling CSV data, configuring chart options, and generating plotly traces based on user input.

classes.name: OverlayChartDialog
classes.description: React component for overlay chart dialog with CSV upload and configuration options.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Resets dialog state and closes the overlay chart dialog.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Validates CSV data, generates plotly overlay data, and adds overlay to chart.
